اقتطعتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعْتُمْ (iqtaṭaʕtum) /iq.ta.tˤaʕ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اُقْتُطِعْتُمْ (uqtuṭiʕtum) /uq.tu.tˤiʕ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
